payout_quote: Get 250 points just for signing up for Subway MVP Rewards. Redeem your points for Subway Cash to use toward purchases. You'll earn 10 points for every $1 spent. Every 400 points = $2 Subway Cash to use toward purchases.
steps: Join Subway MVP Rewards free (Subway app, subway.com, or phone number at the register)
250 bonus points are added to the new account
Points post to the account; once the balance reaches 400 points they convert to $2 in Subway Cash usable toward purchases
catches: Only ~$1.25 at Subway's own rate (400 pts = $2 Subway Cash) - a head start, not free money
Not redeemable until you earn another 150 points to cross the 400-point conversion threshold - Subway-only cash
No purchase needed for the bonus, but the value only lands with ongoing Subway visits
Available at participating restaurants; points may not be earned on third-party delivery, catering, or gift cards
biggest_catch: About $1.25 locked inside Subway's app - and not usable until you earn 150 more points to reach the 400-point conversion.
eligibility: New Subway MVP Rewards member; free to join
timing: Bonus added to the new account; Subway Cash conversion at 400 points.
